description: Acceptance A10. Each check pairs a DAX expression evaluated by Power BI with SQL over the same Parquet exports. A null SQL result must be a blank in DAX. Money is compared to the penny, rates to 1e-9.

checks.name: Net sales, all
checks.sql: select sum(net_amount) from fct_sales_line

checks.name: Net sales, August 2026, by transaction date
checks.sql: select sum(net_amount) from fct_sales_line where transaction_date between '2026-08-01' and '2026-08-31'

checks.name: Net sales, August 2026, attributed to sale date
checks.dax: CALCULATE ( [Net Sales (attributed to sale date)], dim_date[month_start_date] = DATE ( 2026, 8, 1 ) )
checks.sql: select sum(net_amount) from fct_sales_line where attributed_sale_date between '2026-08-01' and '2026-08-31'

checks.name: Returns, all
checks.sql: select sum(net_amount) from fct_sales_line where transaction_type = 'return'

checks.name: Member share of net sales
checks.sql: select sum(case when is_member_sale then net_amount else 0 end) / sum(net_amount) from fct_sales_line

checks.name: Sale transactions
checks.sql: select count(*) from fct_transaction where transaction_type = 'sale'

checks.name: Average basket
checks.sql: select (select sum(net_amount) from fct_sales_line) / (select count(*) from fct_transaction where transaction_type = 'sale')

checks.name: Average basket, members
checks.sql: select (select sum(net_amount) from fct_sales_line where is_member_sale) / (select count(*) from fct_transaction where transaction_type = 'sale' and is_member_sale)

checks.name: Average basket, anonymous
checks.sql: select (select sum(net_amount) from fct_sales_line where not is_member_sale) / (select count(*) from fct_transaction where transaction_type = 'sale' and not is_member_sale)

checks.name: Trading days, S012, June 2025 (opened 16 June)
checks.sql: select count(*) from dim_date d join dim_store s on s.store_id = 'S012' and d.date_day >= greatest(s.valid_from_date, s.opened_date) and d.date_day < s.valid_to_date where d.month_start_date = '2025-06-01' and not d.is_after_as_of_date

checks.name: Net sales per trading day, S012, June 2025
checks.dax: CALCULATE ( [Net Sales per Trading Day], dim_store[store_id] = "S012", dim_date[month_start_date] = DATE ( 2025, 6, 1 ) )
checks.sql: select sum(l.net_amount) / 15 from fct_sales_line l join dim_store s using (store_version_id) where s.store_id = 'S012' and l.transaction_date between '2025-06-01' and '2025-06-30'

checks.name: Trading days, S007 while in the North (since 1 January 2026)
checks.sql: select count(*) from dim_date d join dim_store s on s.store_id = 'S007' and s.region = 'North' and d.date_day >= greatest(s.valid_from_date, s.opened_date) and d.date_day < s.valid_to_date where not d.is_after_as_of_date

checks.name: Eligible members, September 2026
checks.sql: select count(*) from fct_member_month where month_start_date = '2026-09-01' and is_eligible

checks.name: Eligible members, whole year 2026 (snapshot: last month, not a sum)
checks.sql: select count(*) from fct_member_month where month_start_date = '2026-09-01' and is_eligible

checks.name: Inactive members, September 2026
checks.sql: select count(*) from fct_member_month where month_start_date = '2026-09-01' and is_eligible and not is_active

checks.name: Inactivity rate, September 2026
checks.sql: select sum(case when not is_active then 1 else 0 end) / count(*) from fct_member_month where month_start_date = '2026-09-01' and is_eligible

checks.name: Active members, September 2026
checks.sql: select count(*) from fct_member_month where month_start_date = '2026-09-01' and is_active

checks.name: Redemption rate, all
checks.sql: select sum(case when is_redeemed then 1 else 0 end) / sum(case when is_resolved then 1 else 0 end) from fct_reward_entitlement

checks.name: Redemption rate, birthday offers
checks.sql: select sum(case when is_redeemed then 1 else 0 end) / sum(case when is_resolved then 1 else 0 end) from fct_reward_entitlement where reward_type = 'birthday_offer'

checks.name: Open entitlements
checks.sql: select count(*) from fct_reward_entitlement where resolved_status = 'open'

checks.name: Status conflicts
checks.sql: select count(*) from fct_reward_entitlement where has_status_conflict

checks.name: Redemptions at S001
checks.sql: select count(*) from fct_reward_entitlement where is_redeemed and redeemed_store_id = 'S001'

checks.name: Repeat purchase rate, July 2026 cohort (mature)
checks.sql: select repeat_member_count / cohort_member_count from agg_repeat_purchase_cohort where cohort_month_start_date = '2026-07-01'

checks.name: Repeat purchase rate, August 2026 cohort (immature: blank)
checks.sql: select null

checks.name: Repeat purchase rate, 2025 cohorts
checks.sql: select sum(repeat_member_count) / sum(cohort_member_count) from agg_repeat_purchase_cohort where cohort_month_start_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-01'

checks.name: Repeat purchase rate, all cohorts (some immature: blank)
checks.sql: select null

checks.name: Retention rate, January 2025 cohort, month 6
checks.sql: select active_member_count / cohort_member_count from agg_retention_cohort where cohort_month_start_date = '2025-01-01' and months_since_enrolment = 6

checks.name: Tests in the last build
checks.sql: select count(*) from dq_test_result where run_started_at = (select max(run_started_at) from dq_test_result)

checks.name: Failed tests in the last build
checks.sql: select count(*) from dq_test_result where run_started_at = (select max(run_started_at) from dq_test_result) and status in ('fail', 'error')

checks.name: As-of date
checks.sql: select max(date_day) from dim_date where not is_after_as_of_date

checks.name: RLS allowed: Region North sees North net sales
checks.sql: select sum(l.net_amount) from fct_sales_line l join dim_store s using (store_version_id) where s.region = 'North'

checks.name: RLS denied: Region North sees nothing of S001 (London)
checks.sql: select null

checks.name: RLS allowed: Region London sees London sale transactions
checks.sql: select count(*) from fct_transaction t join dim_store s using (store_version_id) where s.region = 'London' and t.transaction_type = 'sale'

checks.name: RLS scope: programme-wide redemption rate is not filtered by region
checks.sql: select sum(case when is_redeemed then 1 else 0 end) / sum(case when is_resolved then 1 else 0 end) from fct_reward_entitlement
